senses.en: to say something more
senses.pattern: add that… / he added / I should add (that)…
senses.example: The coach praised the team's effort and [[added]] that Friday's practice would start an hour early.
senses.example_zh: 教練稱讚了全隊的努力，並補充說週五的練習會提早一小時開始。

gsat.sentence: But, he [[added]], “I love my brother very much.
I should [[add]], perhaps, that I did tell my friends what had happened to them, after the event was over, and gave them the option of destroying the tape.

senses.en: a particular manner, appearance, or feeling
senses.pattern: an air of confidence / an air of mystery / with an air of authority
senses.example: The new coach walked into the gym with an [[air]] of quiet confidence that calmed the players.
senses.example_zh: 新教練帶著沉穩自信的神態走進體育館，讓球員們安心下來。
senses.note: put on airs 意為「擺架子」

senses.en: to broadcast a program, or to be broadcast
senses.pattern: air a show / air live / be aired on television
senses.example: The documentary about sea turtles will [[air]] on public television next Sunday evening at eight.
senses.example_zh: 這部關於海龜的紀錄片將於下週日晚間八點在公共電視播出。

senses.en: only; without including anything else
senses.pattern: last year alone / in this city alone / price alone / this fact alone
senses.example: Last month [[alone]], the animal shelter took in over two hundred abandoned cats and dogs.
senses.example_zh: 單單上個月，這間動物收容所就收容了兩百多隻遭棄養的貓狗。
senses.note: 置於所修飾的名詞之後

gsat.sentence: In the year 1990 [[alone]], the growth in trade in services was as high as 19%.
It is reported that hip-hop fashion [[alone]] generates $750 million to $1 billion annually.

senses.en: to be held responsible for something
senses.pattern: answer for one's actions / answer for the consequences / answer to sb for sth
senses.example: Anyone who damages the school's lab equipment on purpose will have to [[answer]] for it.
senses.example_zh: 任何故意損壞學校實驗室設備的人，都必須對此負責。

senses.en: to match a description or satisfy a need
senses.pattern: answer a description / answer a need / answer the purpose
senses.example: A man [[answering]] the witness's description was seen leaving the museum shortly before the alarm rang.
senses.example_zh: 有人看到一名符合目擊者描述的男子，在警報響起前不久離開博物館。

senses.en: to understand fully how serious or important something is
senses.pattern: appreciate the difficulty / appreciate the importance of / fully appreciate that
senses.example: Few visitors [[appreciate]] how dangerous the mountain trail becomes after a heavy afternoon rain.
senses.example_zh: 很少遊客能體會午後大雨過後，這條山徑會變得多麼危險。
senses.note: 後面常接 that 子句或 wh- 子句

senses.en: to rise in value over time
senses.pattern: appreciate in value / appreciate by ten percent / appreciate against the dollar
senses.example: Experts expect the painting to [[appreciate]] in value as the artist becomes better known abroad.
senses.example_zh: 專家預期，隨著這位畫家在國外漸有名氣，這幅畫將會增值。

senses.en: to support someone or something, often with money
senses.pattern: back a plan / back a candidate / be backed by the government
senses.example: Several local companies agreed to [[back]] the students' plan to build a solar-powered boat.
senses.example_zh: 幾家當地公司同意資助學生打造太陽能船的計畫。

senses.en: to move or drive something backwards
senses.pattern: back the car into the garage / back away from / back out of the driveway
senses.example: The driver slowly [[backed]] the truck into the narrow alley while his partner gave hand signals.
senses.example_zh: 司機緩緩把卡車倒進窄巷，他的搭檔則在一旁打手勢。

senses.en: (become of) to happen to someone or something
senses.pattern: what became of / what will become of / whatever became of
senses.example: Nobody in the neighborhood knows what [[became]] of the old bookstore owner after he moved away.
senses.example_zh: 這一帶沒有人知道那位舊書店老闆搬走之後的遭遇如何。
senses.note: 只用於 what／whatever 開頭的句型

senses.en: to look good on or be suitable for someone
senses.pattern: that color becomes you / blue becomes her / it ill becomes sb to do
senses.example: That dark green jacket really [[becomes]] you; you should wear it to the graduation ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 那件深綠色外套真的很適合你，你應該穿去參加畢業典禮。

gsat.sentence: This situation is so strange to us that we do not know what will [[become]] of it.

senses.en: to be in the right or suitable place
senses.pattern: belong in the kitchen / belong on the shelf / put sth back where it belongs
senses.example: Please put the dictionaries back on the top shelf, where they [[belong]], when you finish using them.
senses.example_zh: 字典用完後，請放回最上層書架，那才是它們應在的地方。
senses.note: 此義不接 to，後接地方副詞或介系詞片語

senses.en: to feel comfortable and accepted in a group
senses.pattern: feel that you belong / belong here / a sense of belonging
senses.example: As a transfer student, Mia felt she didn't [[belong]] until the drama club welcomed her.
senses.example_zh: 身為轉學生，米亞一直沒有歸屬感，直到戲劇社接納了她。

senses.en: a matter investigated by police or decided in court
senses.pattern: a court case / a murder case / win a case / work on a case
senses.example: Police have reopened the [[case]] of the missing painting after a new witness came forward.
senses.example_zh: 新的目擊者出面後，警方已重新調查那幅畫作失蹤的案件。

senses.en: an instance of a disease or a person having it
senses.pattern: a case of flu / confirmed cases / a severe case / new cases
senses.example: Health officials reported over three hundred new [[cases]] of dengue fever in the south last week.
senses.example_zh: 衛生官員通報，上週南部新增三百多起登革熱病例。

senses.en: a set of reasons for or against something
senses.pattern: make a case for / a strong case / the case against
senses.example: The students made a strong [[case]] for starting school an hour later, citing research on teenagers' sleep.
senses.example_zh: 學生們引用青少年睡眠的研究，為延後一小時上課提出有力的論據。

gsat.sentence: In making a [[case]] for or against zoos, both sides argue that they’re saving animals.
In 1993, the Metropolitan Museum of Art reluctantly handed over 363 pieces of gold, silver, precious stones, paintings, and sculptures back to Turkey after a court [[case]].

senses.en: to search a place or thing very carefully
senses.pattern: comb the area / comb the woods for clues / comb through the records
senses.example: Volunteers [[combed]] the beach for hours, looking for the ring she had dropped in the sand.
senses.example_zh: 志工在海灘上仔細搜尋了好幾個小時，想找到她掉在沙裡的戒指。
senses.note: 字尾 b 不發音；comb through＝仔細查閱

senses.en: to have something good, such as a right or advantage
senses.pattern: enjoy good health / enjoy great popularity / enjoy the right to / enjoy a high reputation
senses.example: Thanks to regular exercise, my grandmother still [[enjoys]] excellent health at the age of ninety.
senses.example_zh: 多虧規律運動，我祖母九十歲了仍享有極佳的健康。

gsat.sentence: To no one’s surprise, it has [[enjoyed]] similar popularity.
It has long been assumed that creativity is some unusual trait [[enjoyed]] by the few.

senses.en: clearly and deliberately stated
senses.pattern: express permission / express purpose / express wish / express consent
senses.example: The fund was set up with the [[express]] purpose of helping students from remote villages attend university.
senses.example_zh: 這筆基金的設立有個明確的目的，就是幫助偏鄉學生上大學。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；副詞 expressly

senses.en: travelling or delivered very quickly
senses.pattern: an express train / express delivery / an express bus / by express mail
senses.example: If you take the [[express]] train, you can reach the airport from downtown in under forty minutes.
senses.example_zh: 如果搭特快列車，你從市中心到機場不用四十分鐘。
senses.note: 也可作名詞，指「快車；快遞」

senses.en: not strong or clear; hard to see, hear, or smell
senses.pattern: a faint sound / a faint smell / a faint light / a faint smile
senses.example: We could hear the [[faint]] sound of a piano coming from a house down the street.
senses.example_zh: 我們聽得到從街道那頭一棟房子傳來的微弱鋼琴聲。

senses.en: (of a hope or chance) very small
senses.pattern: a faint hope / a faint chance / not have the faintest idea
senses.example: Rescuers admitted there was only a [[faint]] hope of finding more survivors under the snow.
senses.example_zh: 救難人員坦承，在雪堆下再找到生還者的希望十分微小。
senses.note: not have the faintest idea＝毫無頭緒

senses.en: to shoot bullets from a gun
senses.pattern: fire a gun / fire a shot / fire at sb / fire into the air
senses.example: The starter [[fired]] his pistol into the air, and eight runners burst out of the blocks.
senses.example_zh: 發令員朝天開槍，八名跑者隨即衝出起跑架。

senses.en: to make someone feel very excited or interested
senses.pattern: fire sb's imagination / fire sb with enthusiasm / fire sb up
senses.example: The astronaut's talk [[fired]] the students' imagination, and many of them signed up for the science club.
senses.example_zh: 太空人的演講激發了學生的想像力，其中許多人因此報名參加科學社。

senses.en: shots from guns, or strong criticism
senses.pattern: come under fire / be under fire / open fire
senses.example: The company came under [[fire]] for dumping polluted water into the river near the village.
senses.example_zh: 那家公司因把污水排入村莊附近的河流而遭到猛烈抨擊。

gsat.sentence: His powerful images of Yellowstone [[fired]] the imagination of Congress members.

senses.en: the act of running away from danger
senses.pattern: take flight / fight or flight / flight from the war zone
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the frightened crowd took [[flight]] and rushed toward the nearest exits.
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，受驚的人群紛紛逃跑，衝向最近的出口。

senses.en: a set of stairs between two floors
senses.pattern: a flight of stairs / climb three flights / two flights up
senses.example: My grandmother's knees hurt whenever she climbs more than one [[flight]] of stairs.
senses.example_zh: 我祖母只要爬超過一段樓梯，膝蓋就會痛。

senses.en: the first letter of a person's name
senses.pattern: sign your initials / carve your initials / first and middle initials
senses.example: Grandpa carved his [[initials]], T.W., into the tree trunk when he was a boy.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺小時候把自己姓名的首字母 T.W. 刻在樹幹上。

senses.en: to write your initials on a document
senses.pattern: initial each page / initial the changes / initial a contract
senses.example: Please read the contract carefully and [[initial]] the bottom of every page before signing.
senses.example_zh: 請仔細閱讀合約，在每一頁底部簽姓名縮寫後再正式簽名。

gsat.sentence: Norwegians were prohibited from wearing any symbol of their national unity, such as buttons with the [[initials]] of their king.

senses.en: to live a particular kind of life
senses.pattern: lead a normal life / lead a busy life / lead a healthy lifestyle / lead a double life
senses.example: Thanks to modern medicine, people with diabetes can now [[lead]] active and normal lives.
senses.example_zh: 拜現代醫學之賜，糖尿病患者現在也能過著活躍而正常的生活。

senses.en: a soft, heavy grey metal
senses.pattern: lead poisoning / lead pipes / lead-free paint
senses.example: Old houses may still have [[lead]] pipes, which can make drinking water unsafe for children.
senses.example_zh: 老房子可能還留有鉛管，會使飲用水對兒童不安全。

senses.en: a piece of information that may help solve a crime
senses.pattern: follow up a lead / a promising lead / have no leads
senses.example: Police have received hundreds of phone calls but still have no solid [[leads]] on the missing painting.
senses.example_zh: 警方接到數百通電話，但對於那幅下落不明的畫作仍沒有可靠的線索。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following best describes the life the author is [[leading]]?

senses.en: to be important or have an effect
senses.pattern: matter to sb / it doesn't matter / what matters most
senses.example: What really [[matters]] to the coach is not winning but how hard each player tries.
senses.example_zh: 對教練來說，真正重要的不是贏球，而是每位球員有多努力。

senses.en: the physical substance that all things are made of
senses.pattern: organic matter / waste matter / solid matter
senses.example: Fallen leaves and other organic [[matter]] slowly break down and return nutrients to the soil.
senses.example_zh: 落葉和其他有機物質會慢慢分解，把養分送回土壤。

gsat.sentence: It is not exactly what a child eats that truly [[matters]], but how much time it stays in his mouth.
The dead material and waste [[matter]] form the diet of a group of living organisms called decomposers.

senses.en: an action taken to deal with a problem
senses.pattern: take measures / safety measures / preventive measures / a temporary measure
senses.example: The school has taken new [[measures]] to keep students safe during typhoon season.
senses.example_zh: 學校已採取新措施，以確保學生在颱風季的安全。

senses.en: a way of judging or showing how good something is
senses.pattern: a measure of success / a reliable measure of / a measure of how
senses.example: Exam scores alone are not a fair [[measure]] of how much a student has learned.
senses.example_zh: 考試成績本身並不是評斷學生學了多少的公平衡量標準。

gsat.sentence: You can take some preventive [[measures]] to help avoid the discomfort.
Foggers, or bug bombs, should really be a [[measure]] of last resort.

senses.en: a place where coal or metals are dug; a hidden bomb
senses.pattern: a coal mine / a gold mine / work in a mine / a land mine
senses.example: His grandfather worked in a coal [[mine]] for thirty years before the town switched to tourism.
senses.example_zh: 在小鎮轉型發展觀光之前，他的祖父在煤礦坑工作了三十年。

senses.en: to dig coal, gold, etc. out of the ground
senses.pattern: mine coal / mine gold / mine the area for copper
senses.example: Gold has been [[mined]] in these mountains since the late nineteenth century.
senses.example_zh: 自十九世紀末以來，這片山區就一直有人開採黃金。

gsat.sentence: During the second Industrial Age, people toiled at unusual hours in [[mines]] or factories and often had to get up for work early in the morning.

senses.en: a person who is not important or famous
senses.pattern: a nobody / a complete nobody / treat sb like a nobody
senses.example: Two years ago she was a [[nobody]], but today millions of fans follow her online.
senses.example_zh: 兩年前她還是個無名小卒，如今卻有數百萬粉絲在網路上追蹤她。
senses.note: 可數，複數 nobodies；反義 somebody

senses.en: used to explain or give another name
senses.pattern: geology, or the study of rocks / twelve inches, or one foot / or rather
senses.example: Botany, [[or]] the scientific study of plants, has fascinated her since she was a child.
senses.example_zh: 植物學，也就是研究植物的科學，從她小時候就深深吸引著她。

senses.en: otherwise; if not
senses.pattern: Hurry up, or you'll be late / or else / Be careful, or you'll fall
senses.example: Wear a helmet when you ride a scooter, [[or]] you could be seriously hurt in a crash.
senses.example_zh: 騎機車時要戴安全帽，否則發生車禍時可能會受重傷。

senses.en: during a period of time
senses.pattern: over the years / over time / over the past decade / over the weekend
senses.example: The small town has changed a great deal [[over]] the past twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 在過去二十年期間，這個小鎮改變了許多。

senses.en: while eating a meal or having a drink
senses.pattern: over coffee / over lunch / over a cup of tea / over dinner
senses.example: Why don't we discuss the details of the trip [[over]] lunch tomorrow?
senses.example_zh: 我們何不明天邊吃午餐邊討論這趟旅行的細節？

senses.en: about or because of something
senses.pattern: argue over / fight over / worry over / grieve over
senses.example: The two brothers often argue [[over]] who should wash the dishes after dinner.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟常為了晚餐後該由誰洗碗而爭吵。

gsat.sentence: The movement continued [[over]] the years; however, the problem remains.
The idea for the wind phone was first brought forth by a Japanese garden designer named Itaru Sasaki, who was grieving [[over]] the death of his cousin in 2010, before the tsunami.

senses.en: to describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: paint a picture of sth / paint sb as sth / paint a gloomy picture / paint a rosy picture
senses.example: The report [[paints]] a worrying picture of how little sleep teenagers get on school nights.
senses.example_zh: 這份報告描繪出令人擔憂的景象：青少年在上學日的晚上睡得非常少。

senses.en: to bring an advantage or be worth doing
senses.pattern: It pays to be careful. / Honesty pays. / Crime doesn't pay.
senses.example: It [[pays]] to compare prices at several stores before you buy an expensive camera.
senses.example_zh: 買昂貴的相機之前，先多比較幾家店的價格是有好處的。

senses.en: money received for doing work
senses.pattern: low pay / a pay raise / equal pay / sick pay
senses.example: The nurses are asking for better [[pay]] and shorter working hours.
senses.example_zh: 護理師們要求提高薪水並縮短工時。

senses.en: to suffer because of something you did
senses.pattern: pay for one's mistakes / pay dearly for / make someone pay
senses.example: He stayed up playing games every night and [[paid]] for it with terrible exam results.
senses.example_zh: 他每晚熬夜打電動，結果付出代價，考試成績慘不忍睹。

gsat.sentence: Those college students work at the orphanage on a voluntary basis, helping the children with their studies without receiving any [[pay]].

senses.en: to supply the energy that makes something work
senses.pattern: be powered by electricity / power a car / power a machine / solar-powered
senses.example: The lights on this campus are [[powered]] entirely by solar panels on the rooftops.
senses.example_zh: 這座校園的電燈完全由屋頂上的太陽能板提供動力。
senses.note: 常用被動 be powered by

senses.en: a country with great influence in the world
senses.pattern: a world power / a major power / an economic power / a sea power
senses.example: By the 1700s, the small trading nation had grown into a major sea [[power]] in Europe.
senses.example_zh: 到了十八世紀，這個以貿易立國的小國已成為歐洲的海上強國。

gsat.sentence: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to [[power]] heavy machines, brought about a revolutionary change in society.

senses.en: easily seen; sticking out from a surface
senses.pattern: a prominent position / a prominent place / a prominent nose / prominent cheekbones
senses.example: The warning sign was hung in a [[prominent]] position so that no visitor could miss it.
senses.example_zh: 警告標誌掛在顯眼的位置，讓每位訪客都不會錯過。

gsat.sentence: It appears in a [[prominent]] place on Mexico’s national flag.

senses.en: to give someone the things they need to live
senses.pattern: provide for one's family / provide for the children / be well provided for
senses.example: He works two jobs to [[provide]] for his three children and his elderly parents.
senses.example_zh: 他兼兩份工作來供養三個孩子和年邁的父母。

senses.en: only if; on condition that
senses.pattern: provided (that) / provided you finish first / providing (that)
senses.example: The picnic will go ahead as planned, [[provided]] the rain stops before ten o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 只要雨在十點前停，野餐就會照原定計畫舉行。

senses.en: a particular aspect or detail of something
senses.pattern: in this respect / in many respects / in every respect / with respect to
senses.example: The twins look alike, but in most other [[respects]] they are completely different.
senses.example_zh: 這對雙胞胎長得很像，但在其他大多數方面卻截然不同。

senses.en: to obey a law, rule, or agreement
senses.pattern: respect the law / respect the rules / respect the speed limit / respect sb's wishes
senses.example: Hikers must [[respect]] the park's rules and carry all of their trash back down the mountain.
senses.example_zh: 登山客必須遵守公園的規定，把所有垃圾帶下山。

senses.en: a machine at an amusement park that people ride on
senses.pattern: amusement park rides / go on a ride / a thrilling ride
senses.example: The roller coaster is the most popular [[ride]] in the park, and the line is always long.
senses.example_zh: 雲霄飛車是園內最受歡迎的遊樂設施，排隊的隊伍總是很長。

senses.en: an experience of a particular kind, easy or difficult
senses.pattern: a bumpy ride / a rough ride / an easy ride / a smooth ride
senses.example: New students often have a bumpy [[ride]] in their first semester before they learn to manage their time.
senses.example_zh: 新生在第一學期往往會經歷一段顛簸的歷程，之後才學會管理時間。

gsat.sentence: You may experience the discomfort from the motion of cars, boats, or amusement park [[rides]].
The [[rides]] are custom-designed to accommodate wheelchair riders so that every family member can enjoy the fun.

senses.en: to correct a wrong, or put something upright again
senses.pattern: right a wrong / right an injustice / right the boat / right itself
senses.example: The company tried to [[right]] the wrong by giving every customer a full refund.
senses.example_zh: 那家公司試圖糾正錯誤，全額退費給每一位顧客。

senses.en: exactly; all the way
senses.pattern: right in the middle / right after class / right through the night / right to the end
senses.example: The ball landed [[right]] in the middle of the pond, and nobody wanted to get it.
senses.example_zh: 球正好落在池塘正中央，沒有人想去撿。
senses.note: 放在介系詞或副詞前加強語氣

gsat.sentence: After centuries of technological advancements, it seems we’ve ended up [[right]] where we began in ancient times: with ourselves in the middle, and our destinations at the top.
As tea became much cheaper during the nineteenth century, its popularity spread [[right]] through all corners of the British society.

senses.en: a noisy argument or serious disagreement
senses.pattern: have a row with / a family row / a row over
senses.example: The neighbors had a terrible [[row]] about the noise from last night's party.
senses.example_zh: 鄰居們為了昨晚派對的噪音發生了激烈的爭吵。

senses.en: to have a noisy argument
senses.pattern: row with somebody / row about money / row over
senses.example: The two brothers are always [[rowing]] about whose turn it is to wash the dishes.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟老是為了輪到誰洗碗而吵架。

senses.en: except; apart from
senses.pattern: save for / all save one / empty save for
senses.example: The streets were empty [[save]] for a few stray cats searching for food.
senses.example_zh: 除了幾隻在覓食的流浪貓之外，街上空蕩蕩的。
senses.note: 正式、文學用語；常作 save for

senses.en: to prevent someone from having to do something
senses.pattern: save someone the trouble / save someone a trip / save someone from having to
senses.example: Booking tickets online will [[save]] you the trouble of waiting in a long line.
senses.example_zh: 上網訂票可以省去你大排長龍的麻煩。

senses.en: to add salt, pepper, or spices to food
senses.pattern: season the soup / season with salt and pepper / season to taste / lightly seasoned
senses.example: The chef [[seasoned]] the fish with lemon juice, garlic, and a pinch of black pepper.
senses.example_zh: 主廚用檸檬汁、大蒜和少許黑胡椒給魚調味。
senses.note: seasoning 調味料；seasoned 經驗豐富的

gsat.sentence: Then pour the popcorn into a bowl and [[season]] with a small amount of real butter or olive oil and natural salt.

senses.en: a religious ceremony, especially in a church
senses.pattern: a memorial service / a funeral service / attend a service / a Sunday service
senses.example: Hundreds of villagers attended the memorial [[service]] held for the fishermen lost in the storm.
senses.example_zh: 數百位村民參加了為暴風雨中罹難漁民舉行的追思儀式。

senses.en: to examine and repair a vehicle or machine regularly
senses.pattern: service a car / have the air conditioner serviced / be regularly serviced
senses.example: You should have your scooter [[serviced]] every six months to make sure the brakes work properly.
senses.example_zh: 你應該每六個月把機車送去保養一次，以確保煞車運作正常。

senses.en: work or time spent in the armed forces or government
senses.pattern: military service / do one's military service / public service / years of service
senses.example: After two years of military [[service]], he returned home and opened a small repair shop.
senses.example_zh: 服完兩年兵役後，他回到家鄉開了一間小修理店。

gsat.sentence: In some countries, military [[service]] is compulsory for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.

senses.en: a place where water flows up from the ground
senses.pattern: a hot spring / a mountain spring / spring water
senses.example: Hikers filled their bottles at a cold [[spring]] halfway up the mountain trail.
senses.example_zh: 登山客在山徑半途的一處冷泉把水壺裝滿。

senses.en: to appear suddenly; to jump quickly
senses.pattern: spring up / spring to mind / spring to one's feet
senses.example: Dozens of food stalls [[sprang]] up near the stadium as soon as the tournament was announced.
senses.example_zh: 錦標賽一宣布，體育場附近就突然出現了數十個小吃攤。

senses.en: a coiled piece of metal that returns to shape
senses.pattern: a metal spring / bed springs / a broken spring
senses.example: One of the [[springs]] in the old sofa had broken, so sitting on it was uncomfortable.
senses.example_zh: 舊沙發裡的一根彈簧斷了，所以坐起來很不舒服。

gsat.sentence: Since the 1970s, book towns like Hay-on-Wye have been [[springing]] up all over the world.
The Tuck family has discovered a [[spring]] whose water brings eternal life.

senses.en: to follow someone closely and secretly
senses.pattern: tail a suspect / tail a car / be tailed by
senses.example: Two detectives [[tailed]] the suspect's car across the city without being noticed once.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警探跟蹤嫌犯的車穿越整座城市，一次也沒被發現。

senses.en: the side of a coin without a head on it
senses.pattern: heads or tails / call tails / come up tails
senses.example: The captain called [[tails]], the coin landed on heads, and the other team got to kick first.
senses.example_zh: 隊長猜反面，結果硬幣是正面朝上，於是由另一隊先開球。
senses.note: 用複數 tails；正面為 heads

senses.en: a fixed period of time that something lasts
senses.pattern: a term of office / a four-year term / serve a second term / a prison term
senses.example: The club president is elected for a [[term]] of one year and may run again.
senses.example_zh: 社長的任期為一年，期滿後可再次參選。

senses.en: the conditions of an agreement
senses.pattern: terms and conditions / the terms of a contract / under the terms of / agree to the terms
senses.example: Read the [[terms]] of the contract carefully before you sign it, especially those about refunds.
senses.example_zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約的條款，尤其是與退費有關的部分。

senses.en: to give a particular name to something
senses.pattern: be termed + N/adj. / what is termed / term sth a success
senses.example: Psychologists [[term]] this common habit of putting off important tasks procrastination.
senses.example_zh: 心理學家把這種拖延重要事務的常見習慣稱為拖延症。

gsat.sentence: However, their demand is high because many people buy them to tell the world that they have money, [[termed]] as conspicuous consumption in economics.

senses.en: to increase a price, amount, or level
senses.pattern: up the price / up the pace / up one's game
senses.example: The airline [[upped]] its ticket prices twice last year because of rising fuel costs.
senses.example_zh: 由於燃料成本上漲，這家航空公司去年兩度提高票價。

senses.en: (of a period of time) finished
senses.pattern: time is up / when the two weeks are up / before the hour is up
senses.example: When the thirty minutes were [[up]], the teacher told everyone to put down their pens.
senses.example_zh: 三十分鐘時間一到，老師就要大家把筆放下。
senses.note: 只放在 be 動詞後

senses.en: a limited period when something can be done
senses.pattern: a window of opportunity / a narrow window / a two-hour window / the window closes
senses.example: Doctors have only a short [[window]] of a few hours to treat patients after a stroke.
senses.example_zh: 中風之後，醫師只有短短幾小時的時機可以救治病人。

senses.en: a way of seeing and learning about something
senses.pattern: a window on / a window into / a window to the world
senses.example: Old letters like these offer a [[window]] into the daily lives of people a century ago.
senses.example_zh: 像這樣的舊信件提供了一個窗口，讓人了解一百年前人們的日常生活。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the new high-speed rail station, land in this once-quiet town has ______ sharply, with prices doubling in just five years.
quiz.explain_zh: appreciate＝增值。高鐵站設立後，小鎮的土地五年內價格翻倍。

quiz.stem: The handwriting on the hundred-year-old letter was so ______ that the historians needed a special lamp to read it.
quiz.explain_zh: faint＝模糊的、微弱的。百年信件上的字跡太模糊，要用特殊的燈才能讀。

quiz.stem: Students may borrow the lab's cameras over the weekend, ______ they sign a form and promise to return the equipment by Monday morning.
quiz.explain_zh: provided＝只要。只要簽表單並承諾週一早上歸還，就能借相機。

quiz.stem: Under the school's privacy rules, teachers cannot share a student's grades with anyone outside the family without the ______ consent of the parents.
quiz.explain_zh: express＝明確的。未經家長明確同意，老師不得把學生成績透露給外人。

quiz.stem: Because the elevator was out of order, the delivery man had to carry the heavy boxes up five ______ of stairs to reach our apartment.
quiz.explain_zh: flight＝一段樓梯。電梯故障，送貨員只好搬著箱子爬五段樓梯。

quiz.stem: Under the ______ of the scholarship, students must keep an average grade of 85 or above and complete 40 hours of community service each year.
quiz.explain_zh: term＝（複數）條款、條件。依獎學金的條款，學生須維持成績並做社區服務。

quiz.stem: After the powerful earthquake, rescue teams ______ the ruins of the apartment building for two days, hoping to find survivors trapped underneath.
quiz.explain_zh: comb＝仔細搜尋。救難隊在公寓廢墟中徹底搜尋受困的生還者。

quiz.stem: Although the remake follows the original film closely, it is superior in one important ______: the actors' performances feel far more natural.
quiz.explain_zh: respect＝方面。重拍版在一個重要方面勝過原作：演員的演出自然得多。

quiz.stem: The typhoon caused heavy losses across the region; in one southern county ______, over two thousand hectares of banana farms were destroyed.
quiz.explain_zh: alone＝僅僅、單單。單單南部一個縣就有兩千多公頃蕉園被毀。

quiz.stem: After several students were injured at the crossing, the city took strict ______ to slow down traffic near the school.
quiz.explain_zh: measure＝措施。學生在路口受傷後，市府採取嚴格措施減緩車速。
